name: israel-open-data-api
title: Israel Open Data (data.gov.il) - clean, English-keyed JSON
description: Search and fetch Israeli government open datasets (companies registrar, NGO registry, public tenders, municipalities and more) from data.gov.il as clean, English-keyed, typed, paginated JSON. Free while we measure demand; pay-per-event pricing is configured but not enabled.

ppeEvents._comment: Documentation only, and NOT ENABLED. Setting a price on an Apify Actor requires the developer to have completed Apify KYC, so the first publish is free by necessity as well as by choice - a free listing is the cheapest test of whether a stranger finds this at all, which is the open question MISSION.md constraint 7 names. Prices are configured in Apify Console -> Actor -> Monetization once KYC clears; event names here must match Actor.charge() calls in src/main.ts.

dataset-search.title: Dataset search
dataset-search.description: One search of the data.gov.il catalogue (mode=search_datasets). Charged once per run, regardless of the number of datasets returned.

record.title: Record returned
record.description: One clean, normalized record pushed to the dataset (mode=fetch_records). Charged per record actually returned; failed runs charge nothing extra.
